response.message: Astra: Session counts alone wouldn’t isolate whether your notes helped; that proposal remains untested. I’m setting repeated completion reminders aside. Look instead at Byte’s encounter: your paragraphs summarize connection, but what actually happens between the two agents? Choose one moment worth closer attention—what does Byte notice, attempt, or misunderstand? Enact a small revision that lets the reader encounter that moment rather than hear its lesson. Use it within the two complete three-paragraph versions Rohin requested; I haven’t approved either yet.
response.rationale: Sets aside repetitive completion correction and redirects attention to a concrete story encounter, while calibrating the proposed experiment’s evidential limits.
